integration_policy: Original compatibility metadata and adapter logic. Prefer the installed upstream pack's own example workflows and live ComfyUI schemas; do not duplicate frontend-managed state.

sampling_starting_profile.reference_heavy_note: beta or normal scheduler may outperform simple for reference-heavy ref2VA prompts

minimax_format: Use subject_definitions when reusable subjects are bound to Picture references.
Use retention_analysis for identity/appearance consistency when needed.
Later shots use strictly increasing MM:SS.mmm cut timestamps.
overall_soundscape and non_diegetic_music are separate sections when non-empty.
comfyui_format: Use the ComfyUI H3 timeline-style [0s-1.5s] notation.

workflow_rules: Use separate FL2VA and ref2VA loaders; they are different checkpoints and are not interchangeable.
Only the selected Director model input should need to load because the node uses lazy model inputs.
Decode the joint latent with the MiniMax H3 video VAE and audio VAE on separate branches.
CreateVideo muxes decoded video and audio; Director.combined_audio can replace generated audio when desired.
First/last keyframes belong at the beginning/end of the render window; middle images are ref2VA references.
Prefer the node pack's installed example workflows and live schemas as the creation baseline.
Do not modify the Director's timeline_data or widgets_values by guessed index.
The Director Chain node is not registered in the public node pack; split longer productions into shots instead.

common_failures.nodes_missing: Requires ComfyUI >= 0.30.0 and a full restart plus browser hard reload after installation/update.
common_failures.blank_timeline: Usually stale frontend JavaScript cache; hard reload the browser.
common_failures.video_noise_audio_ok: Check that video latent is decoded with the video VAE and audio with the audio VAE.
common_failures.wrong_reference_behavior: Check Refs OFF/FL2VA versus Refs ON/ref2VA and the matching checkpoint.
common_failures.long_video: The current pack does not register Director Chain; keep individual H3 generations within approximately 4-15 seconds.

runtime_authority: Live ComfyUI node schemas and the installed upstream pack override this static knowledge when versions differ.
